name: context-engine
description: Elastic Context Engine memory for Claude Code: recall and remember through AI indices, and save each round's transcript for dreaming.

kibana_url.title: Kibana URL
kibana_url.description: Base URL of Kibana, such as https://my-deployment.kb.us-east-1.aws.elastic.cloud

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: An Elasticsearch API key (the encoded form) for the user whose memory this is.

space_id.title: Space
space_id.description: Kibana space id. Leave empty for the default space.

ai_index_ids.title: AI indices
ai_index_ids.description: Comma-separated AI index ids to use, like an agent's AI index list. Leave empty for every AI index you can read.
